method: Every row of every listed final-model four-view atlas was actually displayed and visually inspected. The exact two-draw captures are distinct from obsolete single-draw scout images.

review_groups.observations: Every row viewed from front, right, back and left. Low prone support retains distinct bent upper arms and forearms; small torso/head breathing motion keeps the idle alive. The shirt drapes along the torso and the trousers trail coherently over the remaining intact preview legs. No new visible skin poke, collapsed elbow, disconnected wrist or abrupt silhouette change was observed.

Actually viewed all six atlases, all four camera columns and every displayed integer frame. Low prone breathing produces small coherent shoulder and head movement. Upper arms, elbows and forearms retain distinct proportions; shirt, waist and trousers retain their silhouettes without visible skin breakthrough, detached pieces or collapsing contours. Trailing legs are intentional in this intact-limb clip preview; actual limb loss is covered by the live demo.

Actually viewed all six atlases, every integer frame and all four camera columns. The low chest and head drift continuously through the second half of the breathing loop; palm, elbow and shoulder alignment stays coherent. Shirt hem, trouser volume and limb lengths remain visually stable, with no visible tear, skin breakthrough or disconnected joint.

Actually viewed all three remaining atlases, every integer frame and all four camera columns including the true endpoint 120. The breathing motion settles smoothly back into the initial prone posture. Elbows remain anatomically defined, wrists stay seated, and shirt and trousers keep their silhouettes without visible holes, skin breakthrough or sudden garment collapse.

limits: Visual review is at 384 x 448 pixels per direction on the final integer-frame captures. Subframe structural and cloth measurements are recorded separately.
This isolated prone-idle preview retains both legs to expose full garment deformation; actual severed-limb states are covered by the live demonstration.
The subtle breathing loop intentionally has much less movement than attacks or locomotion. This is not an independent cloth simulation or an exhaustive physics contact proof.
